original_test_intent: Verify that the UBB board-level thermal metric collection is complete, current, numerically valid and free of unexpected health or protocol errors.
original_method: Securely read the exact approved UBB ThermalMetrics resource, enumerate every expected board sensor, validate units/status/timestamps and ranges, and correlate exceptions with BMC/SEL logs without changing thermal state.
manual_activity: Thermal/platform owner approves the board sensor map, operating envelope and freshness limits and judges exceptions.
required_inputs: Allowed operating ranges, unavailable semantics and sample-age limit
Ambient/workload state and correlated BMC/SEL evidence
safety_requirements: Record load and ambient context before interpreting temperatures
Do not create heat or manipulate thresholds in this case
agent_execution_scope: Capture exact UBB thermal response and health context
Normalize all board sensors with units/status/time
Report anomalies without triggering load, retrying them away or declaring DUT status

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It substitutes `/Thermal` for the source's `/ThermalMetrics`, weakens trust and returns an unqualified temperature dump.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: GET the approved UBB ThermalMetrics resource through verified TLS and produce a full sensor/value/unit/status/timestamp/range table tied to ambient and workload context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Read-only UBB scope and 5/5-minute timing are preserved; no stress stimulus is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate collection completeness first, then evaluate numeric/type/unit/range and freshness per UBB sensor while retaining raw response and related health logs.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Uses the literal endpoint and an explicit board-level oracle instead of an undocumented resource and display-only review.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not substitute per-OAM GPU telemetry for UBB board sensors or introduce a stress test.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A single in-range sample proves reporting correctness at that operating point, not full thermal-control behavior.

project_override_considerations: Only the platform thermal owner can define sensor population, allowable absent states, units, ranges and sample-age policy for this UBB revision.
expected_evidence: Approved endpoint/schema and UBB sensor map
Ambient/load context plus approved range/freshness evaluation
SEL/BMC error correlation, exceptions and engineer verdict

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row181 Wistron-AMD GPU-00174-V002: approve the exact UBB ThermalMetrics resource/schema rather than DeepSeek's `/Thermal` substitution, and define the complete board sensor map, units, ranges, unavailable semantics, freshness limit, ambient/load context and correlated health-log acceptance.

review_improvement: Separates collection completeness, freshness and numeric thermal validity while rejecting the historical endpoint substitution.
independent_technical_reasoning: Thermal values cannot be judged from magnitude alone: the same number may be valid in Celsius, invalid in millidegrees, or stale despite appearing plausible. The evidence therefore needs declared units, update time and operating context per sensor. Board-level UBB metrics also include locations that GPU-local tools may not expose, so later OAM sensor cases cannot backfill a missing board member.
